title: Settle the team-phase coordinator design
request: Deferred from #3: git ref for now. coordinator db maybe in future (not decided)
problem: The team-phase coordinator is only sketched. Questions left open for that phase, starting with whether intents move from git refs to a coordinator database, have nowhere to live, so they could get lost or be settled by accident.
acceptance: Every question deferred to the team phase is decided, or explicitly left open with a reason.

openQuestions.text: Do reviews of other people's changes need to reach the authors?
openQuestions.proposal: Export findings one way as pull-request comments when the change comes through a forge. Replies stay on the forge and never flow back into refs/ldd, which keeps the forge a mirror (#2 Q3). Without a forge, findings only inform your own merge decision.
